# Bounded integration review - PR 465 @ 287ddbc22950a2db5bebc14b30e03e8d1e95e236

Base: `b91d3b4f1f1df6cc9822a1233e60ead8e07f6835`; trusted policy: `190f8f5f2c40a74ed88c3b086366651ca36f8588`.
Lanes: code=APPROVED; prose=APPROVED. This is an integration review, not a fifth full proof review or an automatic carry.

## Findings

<!-- findings:begin -->
- [x] F1 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:924` - Both X/Z marginal nodes remain separate, with arbitrary supplied witnesses, directed opposite placements, ordered consistency inputs and squared-distance bound `4 * deltaQ`. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F2 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:506` - Pointwise and averaged support-mass nodes retain arbitrary vectors, complete POVMs, supported reference effects and nonnegative, not necessarily normalized question weights. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F3 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:2731` - The compression-correlation proof still cites the padded-state quadratic-form node; the different effect node supports the relabeling result. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F4 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1463` - The conditioned-defect proof retains both restricted-average and opposite-placement integrand-positivity dependencies, distinct from the existing conditioning/restoration summary. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F5 (changes) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:430` - The bounded-encoding proof retains its decoder-identity/linearity dependency. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F6 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean:99` - Controlled-unitary prose replaces re-export/import narration. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F7 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/WitnessMarginals.lean:6` - Mathematical description and both ordered relations remain; runtime-limit comments remain removed. <!-- lane=prose -->
- [x] F8 (changes) `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/SupportMass.lean:12` - The codeword-defect, non-encoding marginal-mass and bipartite consistency descriptions retain mathematical wording. <!-- lane=prose -->
<!-- findings:end -->

## Review

The genuine approved predecessor is review `5237785898` on `a72c8dbb1778288b4297cfb05cb6e0fbda068554` against merge base `511cdeda4ecbd71f6285f071abe6f4a7c8119a4a`; the current comparison uses `b91d3b4f1f1df6cc9822a1233e60ead8e07f6835`. I compared the six named paths directly from both Git object pairs. Their main-relative contribution is identical at every added/removed byte: three Lean documentation-only changes plus the auxiliary blueprint nodes in chapters 12, 15 and 16 (+690/-15, 705 changed lines in each patch). The brief's 703-line count is not the Git changed-line count; it does not affect the bytewise equality. Stripping `index` and hunk-header lines reproduces 36,641 versus 36,614 normalized bytes. Their only differences are two *unchanged context* lines: chapter 15 now follows the new marginal nodes with `Resampling a line parameter` instead of `Formalization support for coefficient polynomial agreement`, and chapter 16 now follows the new encoding section with controlled-operator prose instead of the swap-unitary definition header. No added or removed contribution line differs.

**Code lane.** No changed imports, Lean statements, tactics or proof terms. The existing `consistencyDefect_nondegenerateLinePastingDist_le` is in `Combining/Lines/Conditioning.lean:35`, imported through `Lines/Construction.lean` and `Lines.lean`; the conditioned comparison on arbitrary supplied complete measurements keeps the original sample order, opposite placements, integrand positivity and positive inverse retained mass. The current main also proves the relevant global constructors at their direct and nested scopes; earlier descriptions of incomplete constructors are not current findings. This PR does not alter those constructors. No new proof-integrity or statement-drift finding arises from integration.

**Prose and source lane.** The new chapter-15 nodes end before the line-resampling theorem (`ch15:983`), whose distinct label and `\uses` remain intact. The new chapter-16 auxiliary section ends before the existing swap-unitary introduction and controlled-sum lemma (`ch16:602-612`); no label or status is displaced. Chapter-12 links remain with the quadratic-form dependency. All F1-F8 resolutions above persist. Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:882-963` (`lem:qld-xz-lines`, `eq:pasting-q1`) claims a field-valued paired-line measurement over the *unconditioned* product law, with symmetric equivalents, degree support, and polynomial error; the new nodes instead describe supplied-measurement estimates. That source-labelled entry still has `\notready`, not `\leanok`, and the field-answer/source-law identifications remain separate. Paper lines 1267-1289 (`lem:qld-4-7`) require a global projective polynomial-pair measurement; the compression and rounding nodes alone do not claim it. The quantitative non-encoding mass bound remains an uncompleted source node, distinct from the complete supported-reference comparisons. The encoding/decoder dependency is consistent with `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:882-897`. The updated PR description states these current limits without adding completion claims.

**Validation and limits.** Live primary `gh_common.py` reads confirmed open PR head `287ddbc2`, base `b91d3b4`, and nine successful exact-head `local-ci/*` contexts (303s). The recorded rooted audit for this head reports 1,656 PASS, zero FAIL, three statement-only `sorryAx` warnings and no proof-level `\leanok` closure on `sorryAx`. `git diff --check` passed and the detached worktree is clean. I did not run a new build, Lean check, axiom probe, blueprint render, CI, or full proof review. Four previous full reviews and the terminal F1-F8 decisions remain counted.

VERDICT: APPROVED
